title: Skydive Yosemite
specs: Only skydive center with views of Yosemite National Park and Yosemite Valley
Fly over Yosemite Valley with views of Half Dome and El Capitan
Must be at least 18 years old
Must bring valid government ID on day of jump
Additional fees for individuals over 200 lbs: $25 over 200 lbs, $50 over 225 lbs
Cannot jump within 48 hours of scuba diving or 24 hours after giving blood
If taking prescription drugs, must have doctor's certificate stating no adverse effects
Group discounts: $10 off per jumper for groups of 4 or more, $15 off per jumper for groups of 8 or more
includes: Automatic activation devices on all rigs
gap: Exact duration of the jump portion not stated
blurb: Guests do tandem skydiving flights over Yosemite National Park with spectacular views of Half Dome and El Capitan. They jump from the plane and land safely at Mariposa-Yosemite Airport. The experience includes a flight, jump, and landing with all gear provided.
extraNote: $50 deposit required per person to make a reservation, applied to jump cost · Walk-ins accepted only if space available · Deposits may be paid by check if received two weeks prior to appointment · Accepts Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, and cash; no checks for deposits at time of booking · Mariposa-Yosemite Airport, next to the check in office
